snippet.title: Plobania 47/B - The Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4286510/Plobania_47B/

Step into the dark and unsettling world of Plobania 47/B, a dystopian narrative-driven game set in the year 2199, where humanity has achieved immortality and paid the ultimate price.

In a society overwhelmed by overpopulation and strict government control, you take on the role of Milton Clarke, a registration officer working inside a Mandatory Sleep Hospital. Your job is simple. Review documents, follow the rules, and decide who will be sent to “sleep.” But nothing is ever truly simple in Plobania.

Plobania 47/B challenges you with moral dilemmas, ever-changing regulations, and the constant pressure of making life-altering decisions. Every choice matters. Every mistake has consequences.

Game Features:

- Deep, story-driven gameplay set in a rich dystopian universe
- Document inspection mechanics with evolving rules
- Emotionally impactful decision-making system
- Unique characters with hidden motives and personal stories
- Multiple outcomes shaped by your choices
- Atmospheric visuals and immersive sound design

As the system begins to crack, will you remain loyal or question everything?

#Plobania47B #IndieGame #DystopianGame #PapersPleaseInspired #GameDev #IndieDev #SteamGames #StoryDriven #MoralChoices #SimulationGame
